fixed_reflection_theorem.exact_order_justification: Write m=3^a n with gcd(n,3)=1. In characteristic 3, f_{2m,m}(x)=(x^{2n}-x^n-1)^{3^a}. The squarefree polynomial h_n=x^{2n}-x^n-1 has all roots among the 8n-th roots of unity, since y=x^n satisfies y^8=1; moreover it has a root of exact order 8n: choose a generator zeta of mu_{8n} whose n-th power is one of the two primitive eighth roots solving y^2-y-1=0. Hence the semisimple order is exactly 8n. The multiplicity 3^a contributes exactly the unipotent factor 3^a to the companion order. Therefore ord(C)=8n*3^a=8m=4k, while C^(4m)=-I gives antiperiod h=4m=2k.
quotient_identity_steps: C^(4k)=I and no smaller exponent k? exact order of y is 8, so order of x is 8m=4k on the companion cyclic module
fixed_reflection_theorem.statement: For every even k=2m at the reflection fixed point v=m, f=x^(2m)-x^m-1 gives y=x^m with y^2-y-1=0 over F3; hence y^4=-1, so C^(2k)=-I and ord(C)=4k.
